284050834.description:
Wood Tobacco Smoking Pipe
Smooth Briar Finish with Straight Stem
Wood and Vulcanite, 5 Inches
This classic estate tobacco pipe features a smooth wooden bowl with warm graining paired with a straight dark stem. Traditional wooden smoking pipes of this design offer enduring appeal for collectors of tobacciana and enthusiasts. Its balanced proportions and round bowl make it an iconic example of classic pipe design.
Turned wooden bowl with rich reddish-brown finish and visible grain
Classic straight stem with tapered mouthpiece
Round tobacco chamber showing cake from prior use
Measures approximately 5 inches in length
Condition:
Estate pre-owned condition. The wooden bowl shows minor surface wear, small nicks, and natural handling patina. Chamber rim exhibits charring and inner carbon cake from prior smoking. Stem displays light surface oxidation and minor tooth marks near the lip. Structurally sound with no cracks observed.

Petrified Wood Fossil Specimen Natural 13in Brown Green Tan Mineralized Wood

It is unpolished with visible mineral deposits and surface roughness, preserving the original structure of the wood. Suitable for collectors of fossils, minerals, and natural history items.
